title: If saved field choices can't load, the defaults show and the next change saves
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. This case needs the user's saved field and column choices to fail to load. That cannot be caused from the product. Run it only on a test site where a developer has made the saved choices fail to load; otherwise run steps 1 to 3 only and write 'load failure not checked by hand' in the result comment.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • Leave Lead Technician empty.
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, pick Board View and open Fields to display; write down the fields that are on.
  2. Pick Tech View and write down the columns shown.
  3. Turn one Board View field on (e.g. Created date), reload and read whether it stayed on.
  4. (Only with a forced load failure) reload Board View and Tech View and read the fields and columns shown.
  5. (Only with a forced load failure) change one field, then reload once the failure is removed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With the saved choices unreadable, Board View shows its default fields (lead technician name, work order number, customer, unit number, asset, progress, total price, status) and Tech View shows its starting columns (the List default columns).
  • The next field choice made after the failure is saved and is still there after the reload. Without a forced failure only step 3 (a normal save) can be seen.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-N2, S5-N3, read 8 Oct 2026. Tech plan Phase 4 (after a failed preference load the next save re-reads and merges). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N2: “If field preferences cannot load, use Tech View’s starting columns (S5-R4) or Board View’s default fields for the current display.”
  • S5-N3: “Save the user’s next field selection after a preference-load failure.”
